name: Lead Enrichment & Qualification | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Lead Enrichment & Qualification
For each new lead: reads the company website (from the website field or the email domain), has the AI describe the company and score the fit against your ideal customer, logs it, and emails qualified leads to the right salesperson.
1. Fill in **Settings** (routing rules: one per line, `keyword = owner@email`).
2. Make a sheet with a **Leads** tab (`enriched-leads-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets and Gmail. 4. Activate; send leads to the webhook or share the form.

assignments.name: idealCustomer
assignments.value: Industry, company size, region and need of your best customers.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Fill in these values before activating.
